info.name: Team Management — Freelancer API QA
info.description:
Full QA test suite for the Freelancer Management API.

Base URL: http://localhost:8080/api/freelancer

Converted from pytest suites:
  • test_01_crud.py        — Core CRUD lifecycle
  • test_02_edge_cases.py  — Boundary & validation tests
  • test_03_integrity.py   — Cascade delete, manager linkage, password security

Run all folders IN ORDER with the Postman Collection Runner.
Ensure the Spring Boot backend is running before executing.
